pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā bhātuno saddhivihārikassa bhikkhuno ārocesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.3: ahaṃ āvuso sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpanno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.5: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.6: tassa saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.7: so parivasanto taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.8: ahaṃ āvuso sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāciṃ tassa me saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi sohaṃ parivasāmi vedayāmahaṃ āvuso vedayatīti maṃ āyasmā dhāretūti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.9: kiṃ nu kho āvuso yo aññopi imaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati sopi evaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.11: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā so me ārocesi ahaṃ āvuso sañcetanikaṃ sukkavisaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpanno mā kassaci ārocesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.12: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso taṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.14: athakho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.15: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhallaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.20: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādessasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.21: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.8: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.10: cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa ca saṅghādisesā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.12: imaṃ jānitvā codessanti sāressanti khuṃsessanti vambhessanti maṅkuṃ karissanti nārocessāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.1: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhullāpattisaññī paṭicchādeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.2: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā vematiko paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.3: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā aduṭṭhullāpattisaññī paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.5: anupasampannassa duṭṭhullaṃ vā aduṭṭhullaṃ vā ajjhācāraṃ paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.2: saṅghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatīti nāroceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.3: saṅghabhedo vā saṅgharāji vā bhavissatīti nāroceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.4: ayaṃ kakkhaḷo pharuso jīvitantarāyaṃ vā brahmacariyantarāyaṃ vā karissatīti nāroceti
